verdict.rationale: Offline reading, searching and composing with sync on reconnect is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents offline mode, a local cache or an offline write queue. The only storage mention is server-side (emails kept in a Durable Object and an R2 bucket), which is not offline client support. Search and compose are documented only as online MCP capabilities.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
